name: Docker cleanup
desc: Finds dangling images, build cache and long-stopped containers. Prunes dangling images and build cache on its own; proposes removing stopped containers.
prompt: On each selected host, check Docker disk use with the docker.system_df probe and look for dangling images with docker.list_dangling. If dangling images or build cache take space, remove them with docker.prune_dangling_images and docker.prune_build_cache. Look at the container list (get_containers with the host) for containers that have been stopped for more than 14 days; if there are any, propose docker.prune_stopped_containers with older_than_h 336 and name them in the reason. Never touch running containers or volumes. Finish with a short report per host: space before, what was cleaned, what waits for approval.
